    Endpoints of a string and closed-word shapes for Lemma 4.6 #

    For a string w of positive length, position 0 carries the first letter and position n the last letter. Extending arrows at an endpoint are unique (outExt_zero_unique and its variants). The closed words used in the proof of Lemma 4.6 are built from w, its inverse and at most two extra letters; each shape lemma checks that all cyclic adjacent pairs are allowed and concludes representation-infinitude.
